description: Source-informed synthetic scenario inputs for the probability adapter only. ENG is the AI actor; all stock, PP, free-factory counts, relationship arrays, state 16 owner/controller/cores, alert/contamination, and Event 026 global state are declared synthetic fixtures, not observed campaign/save facts. Event 026 arrays are explicit aligned registry values (source id 26, ratio 5000 or 2500, priority 500, eligibility mask 0) with matching active campaign state where applicable. Physical inputs enumerate all five real mask models. No new sale quote, arithmetic temporary, or callback result variable is supplied. Only one relevant recipient/state example is enumerated; world target pools are intentionally incomplete, so no click probability is inferred. Export binds ROOT to ENG donor and FROM to FRA recipient through the actual target helper; its sampled country target pool is incomplete.
